---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

```{python}
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```

The dataset covers Bond films from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.
